verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers event plumbing but no documented user-defined rule engine. Real-time webhooks fire on card transaction events (approved, declined, settled, failed), so users can build their own automations in external systems. Built-in automations exist only as fixed or vendor-defined features: embedded expense policies, automatic emails when receipts or memos are missing, invoice approval flows, and scheduled payments. missing for 10: a configurable if-event-then-action rule builder, documentation of custom trigger/condition/action definitions, rules for non-card events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
